title: Vague 'handle' with no actor and no operations
whyThisCase: 'Handle payment processing for customer orders.' is both a vague-verb plant (handle without operations) and a missing-actor sentence for the quality regex (no human subject, no 'the system'). The planted detection target is the vague/undefined payment behavior. Missing-actor on this line is also a quality-score signal; it is listed under actorChecks as expectHasActor=false without documentedTradeoff because Phase 4 DID flag this one as missing actor (unlike the prohibition tradeoff).

mustExtract.note: Must not be skipped as incomplete English.

ambiguities.note: Payment operations are undefined (capture, refund, retry, currencies, …).

actorChecks.note: HasActor is false here and Phase 4 agreed this is missing-actor. Counted as an actor check, not a tradeoff.
